subject: VectorPay jumpstart: console/API pairing — scheduling
messages:
From: Ethan Ross <ethan@vectorpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: jumpstart console + API pairing next week

Hi Ben,

Are you available next week to run a 2-hour jumpstart session (console walkthrough + API pairing) for our engineering and integration teams? We're targeting a hands-on, end-to-end pairing so they can get keys, make a test call, and try a short prompt/embedding flow.

Attendees (tentative):
- Ethan Ross (engineering lead)
- Priya Malhotra (platform eng)
- Daniel Kwan (PM)
- 2x SRE

Key goals:
- Console: credentialing, project setup, and basic routing/policy examples
- API: authentication, streaming, KV cache behavior, and a quick sample integration

We can do a single 2-hour block or split into two 1-hour sessions if that simplifies scheduling. Attached is our current attendee list (attendee-list.csv).

Preferred windows (PT):
- Tue 6/15 between 10:00–13:00
- Thu 6/17 between 09:00–12:00

If none of those work, I can be flexible with other suggestions. Also happy to share a short list of demo scenarios if your SE needs them in advance.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Ross
Engineering Lead, VectorPay
ethan@vectorpay.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan@vectorpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: jumpstart console + API pairing next week

Thanks Ethan — happy to run this. Copying Marissa (SE) and Soojin (manager) so we have coverage.

We can do either a 2-hour deep-dive or split into two 1-hour sessions (console first, API pairing second). To move quickly, here are three concrete slots (all PT):

- Wed 6/16, 09:00–11:00
- Thu 6/17, 10:00–12:00
- Fri 6/18, 08:00–10:00

If you prefer two 1-hour blocks, we can do Thu 6/17 10:00–11:00 (console) and Thu 6/17 11:30–12:30 (API).

Pre-reqs (short):
- One engineer with console admin access so we can create an API key
- Confirm IP allowlist windows if you have a restrictive firewall
- Share a short sample prompt or integration point you want us to try

I'm attaching our preflight checklist (preflight-checklist.pdf) and a sandbox access doc. If you confirm the attendee list and pick one of the slots above I will send calendar invites and a runbook.

On calendar format — do you prefer a single invite that lists both sessions (if we split) or two separate invites?

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Ethan Ross <ethan@vectorpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@vectorpay.com>, Daniel Kwan <daniel@vectorpay.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: jumpstart console + API pairing next week

On Tue, Jun 14, 2027 at 10:03 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ethan — happy to run this. Copying Marissa (SE) and Soojin (manager) so we have coverage.
> 
> We can do either a 2-hour deep-dive or split into two 1-hour sessions (console first, API pairing second). To move quickly, here are three concrete slots (all PT):
> 
> - Wed 6/16, 09:00–11:00
> - Thu 6/17, 10:00–12:00
> - Fri 6/18, 08:00–10:00
> 
> If you prefer two 1-hour blocks, we can do Thu 6/17 10:00–11:00 (console) and Thu 6/17 11:30–12:30 (API).

Thanks, Ben — appreciate the options. Quick update: our execs moved a prep call into Wed morning and a board dry-run ended up on Thu morning, so the two-hour block on Wed won't work and Thu morning is tight. Could we do two 1-hour sessions on Thu 6/17 but shifted slightly: 11:00–12:00 (console) and 12:30–13:30 (API), PT? That gives us time to debrief between sessions.

Also, request that we prioritize the following agenda items:
- Console: service accounts, key rotation demo, and environment segmentation examples
- API: streaming examples, error handling patterns, and a short example of caching/prefix reuse

I've attached the updated attendee list (attendee-list.csv) with two additional SREs. If that slot works, we'll lock it and expect both teams to be present.

Looks like separate invites will be simpler for our calendar team.

Thanks — Ethan

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan@vectorpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: jumpstart console + API pairing next week

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated attendee list. Confirming two separate 1-hour sessions on Thu 2027-06-17 (PT):

- Session A (Console): 11:00–12:00 PT — owner: Marissa Cole (SE)
  Agenda: credentialing, service accounts, key rotation demo, env segmentation
- Session B (API pairing): 12:30–13:30 PT — owner: Ben Carter (AE) with a deep-dive by Marissa
  Agenda: auth, streaming, error-handling patterns, caching/prefix reuse

Actions I will take now:
- Send two separate calendar invites to the attendees (one for each session)
- Attach the runbook and a short session checklist (session-runbook.md)
- Share a sandbox token for the platform 24 hours before the session

Soojin — letting you know we've scheduled these and will loop in Customer Success for any post-session follow-ups.

Ethan — if anything changes, reply-all and we'll adjust; otherwise expect invites in the next 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: session-runbook.md
